public_evidence_note: This summary embeds all four configurations, actual backend metadata, all twenty round timings and update metrics, source hashes, memory measurements and arithmetic. The retained raw artifacts under runs/ and logs/ are not required to read these embedded measurements.

protocol.condition_order: partition, then device, then algorithm, in CLI order
protocol.warmup: Real collect/PPO/auxiliary updates; timings retained but excluded from estimates
protocol.timing: CUDA synchronized before collection, after collection, and after PPO/auxiliary updates
protocol.host_peak_memory: Process-wide cumulative RSS high-water mark, not a per-condition isolated peak
protocol.scope: One host and short early-training trajectories; repeated rounds are not independent trials
protocol.extrapolation: Linear 10M transition estimate excludes evaluation, checkpoint I/O and startup; margin is planning allowance, not uncertainty interval

estimate_formula.transitions_per_second: sum(timed round transitions) / sum(timed collect + update seconds)

limitations: One host, one seed, fixed sequential condition order, and three consecutive early-training timed rounds; these are not independent hardware trials.
CPU and CUDA have equal initial seed labels, configuration except device, environment metadata and parameter counts, but device RNG streams and numerical trajectories need not match.

CPU timing on the H100 node uses Intel Xeon Platinum 8468, eight allocated CPUs, one Torch thread and serial environment stepping. Existing four-CPU batch-milan job rates are separate measurements and are not interchangeable with these timings.

Ten-million-step estimates extrapolate collect plus PPO and auxiliary updates linearly. Evaluation, checkpoint I/O and startup are excluded; the 50% margin is a planning allowance, not a confidence interval or completion guarantee.

PyTorch peak allocated/reserved GPU memory excludes driver/context and other untracked allocations. Host process peak RSS is cumulative across all conditions; Slurm MaxRSS is a separate process-accounting measurement.

The environment is Gym 0.23.1 Ant-v2 with MuJoCo 2.1.0 compatibility; exact historical binary parity remains unverified. No learning-performance or paper-reproduction claim follows from these systems measurements.
